title: FairFund-Bench: Evaluating Distributive Bias in LLM Resource Allocation

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution using validated race-signaling names in synthetic financial aid requests, measuring disparities in LLM-assigned ratings, rankings, and monetary allocations across single and multi-stimulus prompt structures.
